users.description: Full issuer-prefixed identity subjects `<issuer>#<sub>`, operator-supplied, one per identity granted this tenant. The chart renders one RoleBinding per identity granting that user the provision-identity ClusterRole in this namespace. Empty renders no binding. The prefix is enforced: cluster-protect-security selects tenant-scoped callers by it, so a subject without one would hold the provision-identity verbs while sitting outside the policy's reach. Neither the issuer nor the sub may carry a quote, backslash, control character, or Unicode line or paragraph separator, matching the user command's admission rule.
